title: Briefcase engine (oci-jj) install
one_line: Install the licensed engine from the portal, verified against a pinned key.
verified_against: Offline: throwaway P-256 key signing in the cosign blob format, fake platform (install codes, presigned downloads), fake docker/skopeo/xattr/cosign, with and without cryptography. Real: docker load of a signed OCI archive on Docker 29.10 (classic vfs and containerd stores). Not run: the real portal, S3, ECR, KMS, cosign, macOS; no release key ships yet.
